image_description: A flat-lay photograph of an open vintage comic book or graphic novel spread. The pages show signs of age (yellowing/foxing). The layout consists of multiple irregular panels containing surreal, psychedelic artwork with bold outlines and vibrant but faded colors. Visible elements include stylized characters, speech bubbles with text, caption boxes, and dynamic action poses. The spine/binding area is visible in the center left.

The aging/foxing effect on the paper looks somewhat uniform and digitally applied rather than natural physical degradation, but this is minor.
